tools.name: verify_xrp_payment
tools.description: Submit an XRP transaction hash for FDC attestation on Flare. Subscription API keys inside quota are not charged extra. Without a key, or over quota, the tool returns an x402 payment challenge (XRP or RLUSD via the XRPL facilitator). A valid PAYMENT-SIGNATURE pays for exactly one attestation. Status

tools.name: get_attestation_status
tools.description: Get the current status of an attestation by its UUID. Call this after verify_xrp_payment to check if the proof is ready and verified on-chain.

tools.name: lookup_attestation_by_tx
tools.description: Look up an attestation by its original XRP transaction hash. Returns the full attestation record if one exists.

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Get XRPLink server information, network details, contract addresses, and white-label branding.

tools.name: get_attestation_by_round
tools.description: List all attestations for a given FDC voting round ID.
